titulo_es: Transmit a notice with the public

bloques.titulo: It also provides information on a person, institution or notice.
texto: It is common in formal and indirect communication. It attributes the content; it does not in itself guarantee that the speaker has checked it.
The company reports that it will change the meeting in the afternoon.
The train will be delayed for about 15 minutes.
